name: The Rapture
overview: The Rapture is understood as a future event when Jesus Christ will come visibly with clouds, as described in Revelation 1:7, and all people will witness His return. Believers who have remained faithful and kept the word of Christ's patience will be preserved from the coming hour of trial that will affect the whole world, according to Revelation 3:10. This hope is rooted in the anticipation of Christ’s return following the signs He spoke of, such as those alluded to in Matthew 24:1, where Jesus prepares His disciples for future events surrounding His coming.
